Assistant B provides a more accurate, detailed, and culturally nuanced overview of Japanese business etiquette. It covers key aspects such as the proper handling of business cards, bowing, honorifics, gift-giving customs, decision-making processes, non-verbal communication, and relationship-building through socializing—all with practical guidance. Assistant A’s response is superficial, contains inaccuracies (e.g., gender roles, meeting length), and repeats points without adding depth.
